text:
tara_marketing: Quick thread — HorizonAI case draft ready for review. We need: customer-approved quote, legal signoff on metrics, webinar co-host confirmation, and inbound lead routing before publish window (target 2026-05-05).
lee_pm: I read the draft. Main thing: the benchmark paragraph calls out 2.4x cost reduction on our standard latency profile. Horizon asked to soften that unless we cite the test harness. Can we add a single-sentence caveat?
diego_cs: Jordan (Horizon AE) prefers: 'measured under our lab config' -> but they want it less technical. Suggest: 'measured in Redwood internal benchmark under standard production settings.'
tara_marketing: Proposed hero line: "HorizonAI scales multimodal searches with lower inference cost and improved throughput". Thoughts?
lee_pm: Good. Maybe flip: "Lower inference cost and improved throughput for HorizonAI's multimodal search" — puts the benefit first.
noelle_legal: Two legal items: 1) need explicit written approval of the quote wording and the benchmark sentence; 2) permission to use HorizonAI logo and a screenshot with hostnames redacted. Also flag: no internal tuning details.

noelle_legal: Draft permission checklist below — please review.
HorizonAI marketing permission checklist:
1) Signed approval of final customer quote (exact text to be embedded)
2) Written confirmation of permission to use HorizonAI name and logo
3) Written confirmation to publish benchmark claim as written (or an agreed caveat)
4) Approval to use provided screenshot(s) with hostnames/IDs removed
5) Embargo window: publish not before 2026-05-05 09:00AM PT

aj_growth: For routing/workflow: once live, set campaign source=horizonai-case and utm_medium=case-study. Send automated lead tag to SF AE pool and trigger a webinar nurture if contact opens >1 email. For high-fit leads (score >= 80) add to SDR fast queue.
tara_marketing: Webinar note: HorizonAI can co-present but asked for a 20-min slot, 10-min demo. Need to confirm speaker name and slide deck reuse rights. Also want a short customer quote we can put on slide 2.
diego_cs: I'll ask the customer for the quote during our Friday sync and get their preferred speaker. Will try to get it in writing there.
lee_pm: Also recommend we include an appendix slide with test conditions (brief) that references our benchmark harness and links to a public repo snippet. That keeps claims transparent.
noelle_legal: Appendix is fine, but don't publish nonpublic config values. A link to a sanitized harness snippet is OK.
tara_marketing: Social cadence draft: 1) publish announcement + blog on day 0, 2) push 2 shorter social posts day 1 and day 4, 3) webinar invite sequence (email 7 days before, reminder 1 day before, day-of). Can we get the comms ops to queue these?
aj_growth: Yep — I'll add the sequence to the campaign and pre-populate creative placeholders. Also set conversion tags: webinar_reg, case_download, demo_request.
launch-bot: Reminder scheduled: "HorizonAI case final signoff" on 2026-05-04T18:00:00Z (calendar invite sent).
noelle_legal: One more: include explicit customer opt-in for reusing their quote in partner co-marketing (if partner webinars happen). If HorizonAI says no, we must not share outside Redwood channels.
diego_cs: Noted — I'll include that opt-in checkbox in the permission email.
tara_marketing: Timeline recap:
• 5/1 — internal draft review and revise hero + benchmark caveat
• 5/2 — Diego to get customer-approved quote and slide permission
• 5/3 — Legal sends final permission packet and receives signed copy
• 5/4 — Marketing finalizes assets and campaign configuration
• 5/5 09:00AM PT — Embargo lifts; publish + social + open webinar signup

tara_marketing: I'll update the composer doc with the revised hero and appendix pointer. Flag anything blocking here. :rocket:
